project_meta.name: Fotbollsplan Bevattning - As-Built 2025
project_meta.description: System configuration with hybrid pipe network (PEM 90/75/50).
project_meta.instructions_for_copilot: Use the pipe dimensions defined here to estimate pressure drops. Zone 7 has higher friction due to PEM 50 (50mm inner diameter) compared to Zone 5 with PEM 75 (75mm). Smaller diameter = higher friction = lower pressure. This is by design - Zone 7's PEM 50 provides natural pressure dampening from >10 bar to ~8-9 bar, protecting equipment. See PIPE_NETWORK_DOCUMENTATION.md for full hydraulic analysis.

constraints.warning: Pump creates high static pressure (>10 bar) at low flow rates.

zones.pressure_note: Direct feed from PEM 75 - large diameter = low friction = high pressure.
zones.comparison: Larger pipe than Zone 7 (PEM 75 vs PEM 50) results in 2+ bar higher pressure

zones.pressure_note: Pressure reduced by friction in PEM 50 pipe - smaller diameter = higher friction = pressure dampening.
zones.comparison: Smaller pipe than Zone 5 (PEM 50 vs PEM 75) provides natural pressure regulation. This is beneficial - protects valves and sprinklers from excessive pump pressure.
zones.technical_detail: Friction loss in PEM 50 absorbs ~2 bar, bringing pressure from dangerous >10 bar down to safe 8-9 bar working range.
